description: You have probably never climbed into a car through the roof. In 1954 you had to: the 300SL's frame sat so high that Mercedes hinged the doors upward instead. title: The 1978 BMW M1 That Missed Its Own Race
description: BMW built 453 M1s for a racing class that had already changed the rules. It needed 400 road cars to qualify, so it hired Lamborghini to build them, then Lamborghini ran out of money and the half-finished cars went to Stuttgart to be assembled by hand. You are looking at a supercar built in five factories for a race it could not enter. Would you call that a failure, or the best save in motorsport?

title: 1977 Oldsmobile Cutlass Supreme - The Best-Seller That Hid A Chevrolet
description: Oldsmobile sold 632,742 Cutlasses in 1977, the best-selling car in America, and some of them left the factory with a Chevrolet V8 instead of the Rocket V8 on the order sheet.
